encounter: E0056 Eddie (Route 110 Trick House), cap 30 - same six, Weavile/Gardevoir lead
availability_audit: Chronology checked against work/reference-pools/pool-30.json source_detail maps and the Game Book chapter order; every source map is at or before Route 110, so a player who has just left Slateport could hold all six. GARDEVOIR (Ralts wild Route102 gate 14 -> Kirlia L20 -> Gardevoir L30) with ITEM_GARDEVOIRITE (stone-window 14, Mega Ring already earned from Steven after Brawly). MAGEARNA (legendary_sign RustboroCity_DevonCorp_2F, gate 14; reachable legend). KARTANA (wild PetalburgWoods_3, gate 20). TOGEKISS (Togepi Route102 -> Togetic friendship -> Shiny Stone, Slateport Mart, gate 24). WEAVILE (Sneasel wild Seaspray_Cave_B1F gate 14, condition evolution). NIDOKING (Nidoran-M wild Route101 gate 14 -> Nidorino -> Moon Stone, gate 20). Nothing here is sourced from Route 111/117/118, New Mauville, the Mauville Game Corner or Altering Cave, all of which come after this battle's map. One reachable legend (Magearna) and one Mega (Gardevoir) are used and declared.
plan: Eddie's whole board is built so Dugtrio's Earthquake cannot hit its own side (Levitate Misdreavus, Levitate Carnivine, Flying Gligar). Weavile leads because Ice is 4x on Gligar, 2x on Carnivine and 2x on Dugtrio while taking Earthquake neutrally, and its Fake Out breaks Dugtrio's Focus Sash. Mega Gardevoir's Pixilate Hyper Voice is neutral on all four but ignores the redirection problem less well than a spread should, so Togekiss is held as the Flying-typed, Earthquake-immune and Arena-Trap-immune pivot. Magearna and Kartana are last: both take Earthquake at 2x.
